planning_notes: Button polarity (active-high vs active-low, pullup usage) is not specified in the wiring facts. Default catalog behavior for digital_input is used (no explicit pullup/active_high override provided). SysML should treat the MODEL boolean true as 'button pressed'.
TM1637 module requirement: when D2 pressed display 1111 else 0000. The program-owned tm1637_number port is a single i32 command; conversion/selection between 1111 and 0/blanking is handled in SysML.
No serial behavior was specified in the requirements; no serial_channels are created.

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 display number (0/1111 mapping handled in model)

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 当 D2 按钮按下时，在 TM1637 数码管上显示 1111，否则显示 0000。TM1637 模块引脚为 CLK=D4，DIO=D5。
